name: skill-hint
description: On each typed prompt, matches keywords in code (no model call) and attaches one line naming skills that may apply, once per skill per session. An archived skill is named with the /unarchive command to run. For perf-audit it also runs the skill's read-only weigh.js once per session and attaches the table, so the facts arrive without a skill load. Also attaches a one-line role loadout (skills, standards, commands) when the prompt names or implies a job role, via skill-scope/role.js. Never loads, archives or restores a skill. For prompts the keywords miss it also runs skill-scope/semantic.js (a script, not this mod) to ask the local Laya model whether debug-protocol or plan-first applies; the script calls 127.0.0.1 only, exits quietly when Laya is not running or a hosted key is set, and the mod stops asking after two failures per session. Reads .ai-dev-kit.json and the project's skill-scope triggers; the mod itself reads no env and makes no network call. Runs: node skill-scope/semantic.js.
